items.quote: Excellent service. I've used them for two separate occasions, mounted TV and hid wires with fantastic results. Caring and meticulous. Very satisfied. Vlad was friendly and professional. Highly recommend.
Vlad did an excellent job mounting my TV! The installation looks clean, level, and secure. He was professional, careful, and made sure everything was done correctly. I'm very satisfied with his work.
Had an amazing experience getting my two TVs mounted. They were quick, efficient and placed the TVs exactly where I wanted them. Will be going back for any other needs I may have!
